final: WITH q AS (SELECT order_id, CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS qty FROM Order_Items WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(product_quantity) <> ''), o AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(qty) AS avg_qty FROM q GROUP BY order_id), ov AS (SELECT AVG(qty) AS overall FROM q) SELECT o.order_id, o.avg_qty AS order_avg_quantity, o.avg_qty - ov.overall AS diff_from_overall FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM Order_Items) d JOIN ov ON ov.overall IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN o ON o.order_id = d.order_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1) JOIN (SELECT 1) ON 1=1 WHERE o.order_id IS NOT NULL OR o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall DESC LIMIT 10
